reviewer_score.notes: No check below 2. Facts check against both BikeAdvice and Rushlane: Rs 2.22 / 2.62 lakh (+Rs 40,000); 286cc; 27.6 PS, 24.5 Nm; six-speed; 690 mm; 11.2 L; 173 / 176 kg; dual-channel ABS; TFT with navigation; the E-Clutch description; first units at BigWing dealers including Delhi; no national schedule. Single-source items were dropped as asked. Photo: Commons '2025 Honda Rebel 300 e-Clutch', Chanokchon, own work, CC BY-SA 4.0; no watermark; no faces in the band. It is a Thai-market show bike, and the alt text says so. Layout PASS. The photo band (y182-872) runs past the nominal 45% line, but it ends about 90 px above the headline (which starts at y962), so nothing sits under text; I accept it. Residual weaknesses that don't cost points: the show floor is busy (a CL bike on the left, crowd behind); the right mirror head is clipped about 8 px at the top edge of the band; the rear indicator touches the right edge. A Honda India press image via the official image lane would be the upgrade next time.
